subject: keycap-cluster
notes: GMK CYL Just Beachy is a keycap-set group buy (productKind: keycap-set) — six CYL-profile keycaps in two staggered rows of three, matching the shared cap template/grid from divinikey-gmk-cyl-ta-neo.svg and kbdfans-gmk-cyl-ramune.svg, per plan/ship-data.md Phase-23 rule (keycap-set -> cap cluster visual). Two center caps (back-middle, front-middle) carry a coral wash + fill for the 'coastal-toned' colorway's focal alpha treatment, matching the article's own heroImageAlt text ('warm-grey line stroke with a coral wash across the two center alpha caps, evoking a coastal-toned GMK CYL colorway') and the coral value already established for this article's inline-viz (apps/web/public/article-viz/gmk-cyl-just-beachy-group-buy-opens/vendor-map.svg, oklch(0.68 0.165 28)). Remaining four caps are warm-grey stroke only, single-splash convention (unlike ta-neo's two-tone slate+neon exception). Background wash uses a warm-bronze/sandy tone (oklch(0.74 0.11 78)) echoing the sandy-ochre splash and warm-paper field of the sibling hero-art asset for this record (apps/web/public/hero-art/gmk-cyl-just-beachy-group-buy-opens.svg). A faint dune-wave echo beneath the ground line nods to the same 'beachy' motif established in that hero-art SVG, kept abstract and low-opacity. Bronze theme dot (oklch 0.80 0.135 75) retained as the fixed family ornamental anchor per novelkeys-gmk-cyl-og-extensions.svg and divinikey-dcs-dolch.svg precedent, independent of this record's own splash palette.
